subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Across Cultures · Reading for Pleasure · Review and Reference
lesson: Reading for Pleasure: The Ethics of Advertising
outcomes: Read an article about ethics in advertising for gist and detail
Decide whether adverts and mock-ups are honest, giving reasons

tf.s: Campbell's put marbles in soup bowls to push the vegetables to the top.
tf.why: This made the soup look full of vegetables.

tf.s: A TV advert usually lasts several hours.
tf.why: A TV ad lasts no more than 30 seconds.

tf.s: Print adverts have unlimited space for information.
'Four out of five doctors recommend Brand X' was meaningless because nobody knew how many doctors were asked.
tf.why: Without that number, the claim tells us little.

tf.s: After the court case, McDonald's put nutritional information in its restaurants and online.
A mock-up is the real product shown in an advert.
tf.why: A mock-up is a copy or model, not the real thing.

tf.s: Using shaving cream instead of ice-cream in an ad does not show the real product.
tf.why: That is why many people think it is not ethical.
Ethical behaviour is fair and honest.

tf.s: Misleading information helps buyers make correct choices.
tf.why: Misleading information gives a false impression.
